rendering: Original sample-free NumPy/SciPy additive, modal and noise synthesis; no sound bank or external audio. Renderer reads the saved MIDI with its tempo map. 44.1 kHz stereo; shared synthesized room; two-pass FFmpeg 7.1 loudnorm targeting -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP, then LAME 256 kb/s MP3. Details and final encoded measurements are in app/render-report.json and app/verification.json.
